RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications merit consideration, but the announcement may omit relevant experience, and leadership or consultation skills may have carried substantial weight.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and how the successful candidate met essential requirements. Frame this around transparency and consistent standards, not panel members’ sex.

If evidence emerges of sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or overlooked mandatory qualifications, consider a formal complaint. Check local review deadlines promptly; waiting for a response may not extend them.
